name: Ginza Blossom Chuo Kaikan
accessSummary: 1 min walk from Exit 1 of Shintomicho Station (Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line) / 8 min walk from Exit 5 of Higashi-Ginza Station (Tokyo Metro Hibiya Line) / 8 min walk from Exit 5 of Higashi-Ginza Station (Toei Asakusa Line)
hours: Reception 9:00-18:00. Closed December 29 to January 3 and one maintenance day each month
notice: Exhibitions, sales, solicitation, contracts and business negotiations for profit are not allowed in either the hall or the banquet/meeting rooms. The banquet/meeting rooms also cannot be used for seminars that charge participation or tuition fees, or for gatherings open to an unspecified general public (the hall may charge admission; for 3,000 yen or more the usage fee is increased by 30%, and for 5,000 yen or more by 50%).

rooms.name: Hall
rooms.note: 900 fixed seats (636 on the 1st floor, 264 on the 2nd floor). Stage is 12 m wide x 7.6 m deep x 7 m high.

ops.prevDaySetup: Usage time includes load-in, load-out, setup, cleanup and entry/exit time, and neither early use nor extended use is possible. Packages sent to the venue before or after the event are not accepted. (Source: Hall / Banquet-Meeting Room "Guide to Use", posted June 2026)
ops.loadingHours: Hall usage slots are morning 9:00-12:00, afternoon 13:00-16:30, evening 17:30-21:30, and all day 9:00-21:30. Banquet/meeting rooms are morning 9:00-12:00, afternoon 13:00-17:00, evening 18:00-21:30, and all day 9:00-21:30. All include load-in and load-out. Goods cannot be carried in or out through the 1F main entrance and must go through the designated place. Stepladders of 2 m or taller cannot be used. (Source: Guide to Use, posted June 2026)
ops.parking: The building has a parking lot, but spaces are limited and cannot be reserved (height limit 210 cm). If it is full, use a nearby car park.
ops.waitingRooms: There are 4 dressing rooms, First to Fourth, at stage left (the First is a 27㎡ Japanese-style room, the Second 55㎡, the Third 29㎡, the Fourth 28㎡), a 58㎡ rehearsal room on the 3rd floor, and a 12㎡ dressing room office on the 2nd floor. Each dressing room has one ITV (in-house monitor), and the stage can be entered from the 2nd floor. Coin lockers are available. (Source: Dressing room floor plan)
ops.catering: Eating and drinking is not allowed in the hall seating area. Outside food and drink cannot be brought into the banquet/meeting rooms (soft drinks in PET bottles, capped cans or flasks are allowed). Food for banquets and meetings is provided by Atable Matsuya Co., Ltd.; banquet courses are 5,500 to 8,800 yen per person (from 20 people, 10% service charge extra), and lunch box menus for meetings are also available.
ops.restaurants: There is no restaurant in the building; food and drink are served in the banquet/meeting rooms (reservation required). The banquet time is 2 hours (until 9 p.m.).
